Pf-9pjJK1e0.title: SQL vs NoSQL | What's the Difference?

overview.summary: The video discusses the differences between SQL and NoSQL databases, explaining their structures, scalability, and use cases. It highlights SQL's relational database format with tables, while NoSQL can handle unstructured data and is more flexible. The presenter shares personal experiences and insights on when to use each type of database.
